name: HISTORICAL Sidewalk Café Licenses and Applications
description:
This dataset contains historical records of sidewalk café licenses and applications, likely from New York City, with 324 sampled rows and 47 columns. Each row represents a business's application for or receipt of a permit to operate outdoor seating on the sidewalk. Records include the license number and status (mostly inactive), business name and secondary name, street address, city, ZIP code, and geographic identifiers such as map coordinates, community district, and city council district. Seating details cover café type (enclosed, unenclosed, or small unenclosed), square footage, number of tables, and number of chairs, along with a Department of Health and Mental Hygiene identifier.

The dataset also documents the application workflow, with separate fields for application status, submission and status dates, expiration and temporary operating dates, and the outcomes and dates of each review stage: intake, plan review, community board review, public hearing, city council review, mayoral review, and license issuance. Many workflow fields are sparsely populated
